usedFor: Eventzilla holds registrations, and Google Contacts keeps the address book that “Create Contact” fills from each “New Registration”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Eventzilla, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: Every person who registers is saved to your address book, so you can reach them after the event.

watchOut: “Attendee Check-In Changes” fires on every change, so “Create Contact” on it can save the same person twice.
